signals.title: The comparison spans different product layers
signals.signal: NVIDIA DGX B200 is documented as a system, Intel Gaudi documentation covers accelerators and inference software, and Broadcom's cited Tomahawk 5 page covers an Ethernet switch; these sources alone do not establish like-for-like substitutes.
signals.interpretation: Normalize the comparison around a specified inference workload and total system scope before making relative capability claims.

signals.title: Comparable transaction pricing is not established
signals.signal: The reviewed product and documentation pages do not give comparable regional transaction prices for complete inference systems.
signals.interpretation: Collect dated vendor or partner quotes with comparable hardware, software, networking, support, and service scope before claiming a price advantage.

signals.title: Cloud availability must be checked by provider and region
signals.signal: The cited IBM announcement places Intel Gaudi 3 in named IBM Cloud regions and describes a planned additional region; that does not establish equivalent NVIDIA or Broadcom availability.
signals.interpretation: Compare deployment options by provider, region, and announcement-versus-current status before drawing conclusions about US and European coverage.

decision_ready_context.business_goal: Compare NVIDIA with Broadcom and Intel for AI computing and data-center platforms. Assess performance, software compatibility, availability, and cost for cloud providers and AI developers in the US and Europe.
